analysis.title: Howmet Aerospace Inc. (HWM): Strength in operating performance and the end markets; Buy
key_insights: 3Q26 adjusted EPS of $1.46 was above FactSet consensus of $1.37. Revenue of $2.7bn was above consensus of $2.59bn. Adjusted EBITDA of $879mn was 5% above consensus of $837mn on a 32.5% margin.
Segment growth y/y in 3Q26: commercial aerospace revenue +32%, defense +10%, commercial transportation +28%, gas turbines +45%.
Reported free cash flow of $562mn was above consensus of $465mn (vs $423mn a year ago). HWM repurchased $500mn of stock in the quarter.

HWM raised 2026 guidance on every key metric: revenue $10.29-$10.31bn (prior $10.00-$10.10bn, consensus $10.12bn), adjusted EBITDA $3.325-$3.335bn (prior $3.21-$3.25bn, consensus $3.26bn), adjusted EPS $5.49-$5.51 (prior $5.23-$5.31, consensus $5.34), FCF $1.95-$2.05bn (prior $1.85-$1.95bn, consensus $1.93bn).
Initial 2027 revenue guidance is ~$11.5bn, up ~12% y/y, versus consensus of $11.58bn, so the first 2027 look is slightly below the Street.
Management expects the industrial gas turbine business to double from its 2025 base in about 3 years.

Other drivers GS cites: higher US defense spending including US missile production ramps, and a supply-demand mismatch for aircraft that supports the aftermarket and OE demand in commercial aerospace.

Engine Products revenue of $1,451mn was 4% above GS estimate and up 31% y/y, with segment margin of 36.3%, 210bps above GS estimate and up 640bps y/y. The segment absorbed 520 net headcount in the quarter.

Fastening Systems revenue of $630mn was 3% below GS estimate and up 41% y/y. Margin of 24.8% was 220bps below GS estimate and down 330bps y/y because of the dilutive margin profile of the CAM acquisition.

Engineered Structures revenue of $295mn was 12% above GS estimate and down 2% y/y (up 8% excluding the Savannah disk forging facility divestiture). Margin of 20.3% was up 330bps y/y on the exit of lower-margin business.

Forged Wheels revenue of $327mn was 16% above GS estimate and up 32% y/y on commercial transportation volumes and higher aluminum cost pass-through. Margin of 22.9% was 250bps below GS estimate and down 220bps y/y on the dilutive effect of the pass-through.
Segment operating margin of 30.2% was 30bps above GS estimate and up 310bps y/y.

GS raised 2026-2030E EPS to $5.51/6.50/7.58/8.78/10.16 from $5.35/6.47/7.52/8.57/9.66, and raised the 12-month price target to $303 from $298. Target uses CY27E EV/EBITDA of 32.5X (unchanged). Rating Buy, price $199.22, upside 52.1%.
The stock is down 28.2% over 3 months and 18.0% over 6 months in absolute terms, and 30.8% and 23.5% relative to the S&P 500. Net debt/EBITDA was 1.3X at quarter end.

market_movers.rationale: Price target raised to $303 from $298 on higher segment revenue and margin assumptions after a 3Q26 beat and a guidance raise. Target is 32.5X CY27E EV/EBITDA.

sector_views.rationale: GS sees growth in commercial aerospace aftermarket and OE, industrial gas turbines and US defense, including missile production ramps.

earnings_insights: 3Q26 (reported 10/30/2026): adjusted EPS $1.46 vs FactSet consensus $1.37; revenue $2.70bn (+29% y/y) vs consensus $2.59bn and 5% above GS estimate; adjusted EBITDA $879mn vs consensus $837mn, 32.5% margin; adjusted FCF $562mn vs consensus $465mn.

2026 guidance (company, updated October): revenue $10.29-$10.31bn vs consensus $10.12bn; adjusted EBITDA $3.325-$3.335bn vs consensus $3.26bn; adjusted EBITDA margin 32.3% vs implied consensus 32.3%; adjusted EPS $5.49-$5.51 vs consensus $5.34; FCF $1.95-$2.05bn vs consensus $1.93bn.
2026 EPS guidance path: $4.35-$4.55 in February, $4.88-$5.00 in May, $5.23-$5.31 in August, $5.49-$5.51 in October.
2027 revenue guidance (company) of ~$11.5bn, up ~12% y/y, vs consensus $11.58bn.
GS estimates (forecast): 2026E revenue $10,309.6mn, EBITDA $3,392.4mn, EPS $5.51; 2027E revenue $11,609.2mn, EPS $6.50; 2028E revenue $12,954.5mn, EPS $7.58. 4Q26E EPS (GS) is $1.50.
Segment operating profit of $817mn was 5.6% above GS estimate. Diluted EPS of $1.46 was $0.09 above GS estimate of $1.37, with an effective tax rate of 20.0% vs GS estimate of 22.0%.
risk_factors: Fastening Systems margin dilution from the CAM acquisition, and Forged Wheels margin dilution from aluminum cost pass-through.
